title: Recommendation as Language Processing (RLP): A Unified Pretrain, Personalized Prompt & Predict Paradigm (P5)
grouping: A large central hub box holds the model name; five prompt boxes are stacked down the left, each under a bold sans-serif task name (Sequential Recommendation, Rating Prediction, Explanation Generation, Review Summarization, Direct Recommendation), and small answer boxes are stacked down the right. A dashed horizontal line near the bottom separates the multitask pretraining tasks (italic label above) from a zero-shot example below (italic label beneath).
shapes_depth: Rounded rectangles with thin black outlines and flat pastel fills; one colour per task (yellow-orange, pink, light blue, light green, pale yellow, lavender for the zero-shot task), and each answer box uses its prompt's colour. Prompt boxes contain the real prompt text in a serif face, with user and item IDs written out. Smooth black curves converge from every prompt into the hub and fan out from it to every answer. The hub is a light-grey rounded square with a thick dark outline.
proposed_highlight: The model is the hub: the largest bold italic text in the figure, in a heavier-outlined grey box at the convergence point of every curve.
lesson: Make the teaser a hub: each task's real prompt text in a box tinted with its own colour on the left, its answer in a small box of the same tint on the right, so colour pairs inputs with outputs through the single model in the middle.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF's first page (RecSys '22). elements 'other' = the converging/diverging curved connectors.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: one central P5 hub box joined by curved lines to six task prompt boxes stacked down the left and their answer boxes stacked down the right, showing one model serving every task

relations.form: a single heavy-outlined grey 'P5' box in the centre receives a curved line from every prompt and sends one to every answer
each prompt on the left and its answer on the right share one pastel tint (orange sequential, pink rating, blue explanation, green summarization, yellow direct, lilac zero-shot)
a dashed horizontal rule near the bottom separates five multi-task pretraining prompts above from one zero-shot new-product prompt below, each labelled in italic
prompts and answers are drawn as real text with user and item IDs written out, e.g. a purchase history '4110 -> 4467 -> 4468 -> 4472' answered by '1581'

channels.colour: pastel tint = task family, shared by a prompt and its answer
channels.shape: large rounded boxes = prompts, small rounded boxes = answers, heavy square box = the model
channels.line: curved black lines = input to and output from the hub; dashed rule = pretraining vs zero-shot split

quality.strengths: Colour has one meaning (task) and links each prompt to its answer across the hub, and the data are shown as real prompts, which makes the text-to-text unification concrete; the zero-shot case is set apart by a dashed rule and labelled.
quality.weaknesses: Every line converges on one point of the hub so the twelve curves bundle and fan out like a starburst and none can be followed by position alone; the model is an empty labelled box with nothing inside; the long prompt texts take most of the area while the right side is mostly blank.

insights.structure: A central heavy-outlined grey hub box labelled 'P5'; five prompt boxes stacked down the left, each under a bold task name, and small answer boxes stacked down the right; a dashed horizontal line near the bottom separates multitask pretraining from a zero-shot example.
insights.data: Prompts are full real prompt text with user and item IDs written out in serif, inside rounded boxes tinted one pastel per task; answers ('1581', '5.0', 'broke immediately') sit in small boxes of the matching tint.
insights.emphasis: The model is the hub where every curve converges, set in the largest bold italic text inside the only thick-outlined box.
insights.flow: Left to right: smooth black curves converge from every prompt into the hub and fan out to every answer; colour, not lines, pairs each prompt with its answer.
insights.avoid: All curves are identical black and cross near the hub, so line identity is lost and the reader must rely on colour to pair prompts and answers; the model's internals are not shown at all.

arrangement.units: one hub composition; prompt and answer boxes are pastel rounded rectangles; a dashed horizontal rule splits pretraining tasks (above) from the zero-shot task (below), each labelled in italic
arrangement.inputs_as: real prompt text in task-tinted rounded boxes with bold task titles above
arrangement.shared: the single P5 hub serves all tasks
